items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: "Ella is going to Europe but let me know when you're ready. You can have her. No headaches."

ctx.x: And he agreed -- he said, "Oh, yeah, yeah." Because I thought maybe he wasn't gonna do it, you know.
But he did. He says, "Yeah, (inaudible)" "Ella is going to Europe but let me know when you're ready. You can have her. No headaches."
This is one of the things that we did, but I did a lot writing instead of going back on the road again.
